title: Storage-only architecture
subtitle: Folders for people. Relationships in governed records.
principle: Drive continues to own the original files and their permissions; GitHub owns governed relationship definitions and approved structured operational data in appropriately permissioned repositories.

distinctions.label: ORIGINALS + PERMISSIONS
distinctions.name: Google Drive
distinctions.meaning: Organize PDF, CAD, images, spreadsheets and other source binaries so humans can browse and retain permissions.

distinctions.label: GOVERNED DEFINITIONS
distinctions.name: GitHub
distinctions.meaning: Version approved schemas, PK/FK contracts, manifests and relationship definitions. Approved operational data only in access-appropriate repositories.

distinctions.label: PUBLIC-SAFE DIRECTORY
distinctions.name: GitHub Pages
distinctions.meaning: Show only authorized links and derived summaries. A page is not a permission grant, a live database or an approved original.

formats.responsibility: Canonical relationship schema and PK/FK definitions in GitHub
formats.qualification: Schema definition is not evidence of a deployed or synchronized database.

formats.responsibility: Append-only metadata observations and audit history
formats.qualification: Keep sensitive observation logs in private governed storage.
A private snapshot is not a public GitHub Pages asset and does not replace original file ownership.
Only approved, public-safe data may go to a public repository.
A review/export format is not automatically the authoritative operational ledger.
Editable operational truth remains with the designated owning workbook/provider; derived exports do not supersede it.

formats.responsibility: Original PDF, CAD, image, spreadsheet and other source files
formats.qualification: Original permissions and provider revisions remain in Drive; browse-friendly folders are not database tables.

rule_title: Do not turn Drive folders into database tables.
rule: Drive should be easy for humans to navigate. Do not create separate folder hierarchies merely to represent database tables, foreign keys, indexes or application modules.
policy: This poster describes a recommended separation, not a claim of a completed migration, linked database, implemented foreign keys, ingestion pipeline, or externally authorized change.
privacy: No private Drive identifiers, private inventory, ACL lists, confidential file names, private operational records or sensitive snapshots belong in this public curation.
